root.label: Trail Blazers hire Braiden Bell as lead TV announcer

events.label: Trail Blazers hire Braiden Bell as lead TV announcer

slots.name: age
slots.sentence: The Portland Trail Blazers fired 29-year-old Braiden Bell on Thursday, just hours after naming him their lead TV announcer, over decade-old social media posts he made when he was a teenager.

slots.name: employment status
slots.sentence: Bell, who over from the WNBA's Phoenix Mercury to replace veteran Kevin Calabro as the youngest primary broadcaster in the NBA, was out of a job before he even put on a headset.
